program.name: Calisthenics Base
program.subject: Bodyweight
program.blurb: The calisthenics basics in straight sets: push-up and squat progressions, table rows and hollow work.
program.about: The calisthenics basics in straight sets: push-up progressions, squat and lunge progressions, table rows and hollow-body work. Push and pull-and-legs days alternate, with abs to finish. Level II moves to harder progressions and Level III slows every lowering to three seconds. A foundation for the harder bodyweight skills.
